title: English rendering of PM’s address at the Centenary Celebrations of UPSC
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 OCT 2026 1:51PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Key Pillars of Governance: PM highlighted the guiding principles of modern civil administration: 'Nation First', 'Citizen First' ('Nagrik Devo Bhava'), and 'Pro-People, Pro-Active, Good Governance'.
Examination Cycle Reform: Urged examination agencies to adopt 'time certainty' by shortening recruitment cycles to promote social and economic equity for aspirants.

Future-Ready Civil Services: Stressed testing candidates for long-term vision, motivation for public service, and complex problem-solving to address emerging challenges like AI, information warfare, deepfakes, and climate justice.

Capacity Building & Diversity: Emphasized leveraging the iGOT platform under Mission Karmayogi for institutional capacity building; noted that female representation among candidates rose from 3% in 1952 to over 30% today.

title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi participates in Centenary Celebrations of UPSC
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 OCT 2026 1:46PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: UPSC Centenary Celebrations: Marked 100 years of the Union Public Service Commission (established 1926) with the release of a commemorative postage stamp, special coin, and a compilation of 100 significant case laws.
Administrative Ethos: Replaced legacy administrative paradigms with 'Nagrik Devo Bhava' and structured governance around Pro-People, Pro-Active, Good Governance principles.

Reforms in Civil Services Recruitment: Mandated reducing exam cycles as an equity reform and aligning selection criteria with problem-solving capabilities required for 21st-century technology and administrative challenges.
Institutional Best Practices: Advocated cross-learning between UPSC and State Public Service Commissions, standardizing procedural norms, and using the iGOT Mission Karmayogi platform.

title: Ministry of Education Approves Five Centres of Excellence for Studies in Classical Languages
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 OCT 2026 5:40PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: The Ministry of Education approved the establishment of five Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for dedicated studies in Classical Languages.

Institutions designated: Classical Assamese (Tezpur University), Classical Bengali (Visva-Bharati University), Classical Marathi (Deccan College, Pune), Classical Pali (Central University of Odisha), and Classical Prakrit (Central University of Gujarat).

Focus Areas: Advanced academic research, preservation and digitisation of textual heritage, wider dissemination of classical knowledge traditions, and strengthening regional higher education ecosystems.

title: India’s First 5.56 km Free‑Space Quantum Key Distribution Link Demonstrated
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 OCT 2026 4:44PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: QNu Labs, BISAG-N, and IIT Gandhinagar successfully demonstrated India's first 5.56 km free-space Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) link.
Achieved a stable Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) below 5% and a secure key generation rate of 230–260 bps.
Integrated QNu Labs' hardware QKD device ('Armos') over free-space optical channels with BISAG-N's software-based post-quantum cryptography platform ('Vedic Kavach').
Provides a foundational architecture for quantum-resilient communications, satellite quantum security, and national secure digital infrastructure.

title: In culmination of 10 years of dedicated efforts, Union Environment Minister and CM (Rajasthan) initiate the process for release of captive-bred Great Indian Bustards into the Wild at Desert National Park, Jaislamer
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 OCT 2026 3:14PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Initiated the rewilding process to release captive-bred Great Indian Bustards (GIB) into the wild at Desert National Park, Jaisalmer.
Bustard Recovery Programme: Collaborative initiative of MoEFCC, Rajasthan Forest Department, Wildlife Institute of India (WII), funded by National CAMPA.
Key Conservation Techniques: Utilizes a 'jumpstart' approach (placing captive-laid eggs into wild nests) and specialized 160m x 64m x 14m Rewilding Aviary at Ramdevra for flight muscle development.
Conservation Status: GIB is critically endangered and serves as an umbrella species for the Thar grassland ecosystem, land degradation neutrality, and Central Asian Flyway migratory birds.
